_note: Required story elements per scene — the 'proper questions' layer (Matt, 2026-08-31). scene_audit.py briefs the judge with the film + these, and every element must be PRESENT.

s1_coldopen.scene_role: The opening: a calm ordinary day at the rescue, so the interruption costs something.
s1_coldopen.setting: the heroes' home ground, peaceful, daytime
elements: Hank, a big round cartoon brown bear with a cream belly
Doug, a tall tan-and-orange cartoon bloodhound dog
a calm, peaceful setting with no trouble, no smoke, no train wreck

s2_thecall.scene_role: The call to adventure: the heroes see that something is wrong.
elements: Hank the brown bear and/or Doug the bloodhound
the characters alert, reacting or looking toward something off-screen or distant

s2b_smoke.scene_role: The trouble is urgent: the circus train is broken down and smoking.
elements: a train with a locomotive visible
thick dark smoke pouring from the engine

s3_rollout.scene_role: The heroes commit and roll out to the rescue on their wagon.
elements: a wooden wagon
horses hitched IN FRONT of the wagon, pulling it
Hank the bear and Doug the bloodhound riding ON the wagon
a sense of motion: dust, speed, wheels turning

s3b_wagonpass.scene_role: The rollout has real speed — the heroes are racing to the rescue.
elements: a wooden wagon moving with dust on a dirt road
horses out in front of the wagon pulling it

s4_arrival.scene_role: Arrival: the heroes stand before the broken-down train; the trouble is visible.
s4_arrival.setting: beside the stopped train, harsh sunlight
elements: Hank the brown bear
Doug the bloodhound
a weathered red train with its boxcar doors shut
dark smoke or heat haze

t1_monkey.scene_role: The trapped: a monkey's fingers curl through a plank gap — we feel who is inside.
elements: wooden boxcar planks with a narrow gap
small animal fingers or a hand curling through the gap
darkness behind the gap suggesting a trapped animal inside

t2_lion.scene_role: The trapped: a lion's muzzle presses at a crack, breathing.
elements: wooden planks with a crack or gap
a lion's muzzle or nose pressed at the opening

t3_giraffe.scene_role: The trapped: a giraffe stands bowed under the boxcar ceiling — too big for her cage.
elements: a giraffe with her neck bowed low under a low plank ceiling
a dim interior with blades or shafts of light through the wall

ellie_eye.scene_role: We meet Ellie: a young elephant's eye at the gap — someone to root for.
elements: an elephant's eye seen close up at a gap or opening
an emotional, intimate framing — the eye large and expressive

s6_heave.scene_role: The effort: Hank forces the jammed door with real physical weight.
elements: Hank the brown bear
a closed wooden boxcar door
the bear's paws on the door, body working against it
effort made visible: dust shaking loose, strain

s6b_heave_close.scene_role: The strain up close: paws flat on the planks, dust shivering.
elements: large paws pressed flat against wooden planks
dust shivering or drifting off the boards

s6_interior.scene_role: The bang felt from inside: darkness, a blade of light, dust falling.
elements: a dark interior
a bright blade or crack of light at the door edge
dust drifting or shaken loose

s6c_light_widens.scene_role: THE PAYOFF: the door opens — light floods in on the trapped animal.
elements: a dark interior with a bright band of light at a door edge
a small elephant visible near the light

r1_monkeys_out.scene_role: Release: the monkeys bound out free across the grass.
r1_monkeys_out.setting: meadow beside the train, golden evening light
elements: more than one monkey
the monkeys out in the open on grass, moving freely
golden evening light

r2_lion_out.scene_role: Release: the lion walks out calm and free.
r2_lion_out.setting: meadow beside the train, golden evening light
elements: a lion outdoors on the grass
the lion calm and walking or standing free, not caged
golden evening light

r3_giraffe_out.scene_role: Release: the giraffe stands tall at last, neck stretched into the light.
r3_giraffe_out.setting: meadow beside the train, golden evening light
elements: a giraffe outdoors standing tall with her neck up
golden evening light

r4_parrots_sky.scene_role: Release: the parrots take the sky — freedom overhead.
r4_parrots_sky.setting: the evening sky above the train
elements: many bright red parrots in flight
a warm golden evening sky

c1_celebration.scene_role: The celebration: the freed animals gather around Ellie in the meadow.
elements: Ellie, a young elephant wearing a red circus cap, prominent in the frame
at least two other circus animals (lion, monkey, giraffe or flamingo) in the meadow with her
a meadow in warm golden light

s8_goodbye.scene_role: The goodbye: the heroes ride their wagon home into the sunset, the rescued train whole and alive behind them.
s8_goodbye.setting: sunset dirt road beside the repaired train
elements: a wooden wagon with the brown bear AND the bloodhound visibly riding aboard
two horses positioned IN FRONT of the wagon, harnessed, clearly pulling it (wagon behind them, not beside them)
the circus train in the scene, whole and steaming
warm sunset light

outro_hank_brag.scene_role: Hank's dry one-liner after the rescue - a tight close-up single.
elements: Hank the brown bear's face large in frame

outro_signoff.scene_role: Doug's sign-off line - a tight close-up single.
elements: Doug the bloodhound's face large in frame
